publisher: SmartNews Media Research Institute, derived from MLIT National Land Numerical Information N03
license: MLIT open-data terms; Public Data License 1.0 under current MLIT terms, with attribution and modification notice
attribution: 国土数値情報（行政区域データ、2021年）（国土交通省）をもとに加工。SmartNews Media Research Institute simplified boundaries.
normalization: Designated-city wards are merged into their parent city by the source publisher; Tokyo's 23 special wards remain separate municipalities. Five-digit official municipality codes are retained with a JP- namespace.
contextGeometry: context.geojson preserves all six excluded municipality geometries and four unassigned features as noneditable context.
exclusionReason: Six Russian-administered southern Kuril municipalities claimed by Japan are outside this selected-country administrative map. Geometry outside Japan's present administration is not added as editable Japanese municipalities.
unassignedGeometry: Four source features with no official municipality code are retained in unassigned-background.geojson and are not invented as municipalities.
islands: No additional size-based island removal. Source retains Ogasawara and other remote islands; map viewport should use mainland focus or scope selection, not drop municipality features.
